title: 第25章 得加钱第26章 前倨而后恭
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“长……长玄……道长……”
王总也傻眼了，一把攥住长玄道长：“快……快出手啊！”
“哦……哦……”
长玄道长呼吸急促，神色慌张，再也没有之前云淡风轻的样子，颤抖着举着手里的铜钱剑，有气无力的喝道：
“何方妖孽！再不滚！贫道就对你不客气了！”
顾铮斜睨这一对师徒，徒弟脸色煞白，全身颤抖，背着的一袋子法器咣当咣当作响，师父那厉喝的样子不要说鬼，有气无力连小孩子都吓不到。
原来这两个道长，高僧都是样子货，半点修为都没有，所谓的降妖伏魔的本事都是在装神弄鬼。
想想也挺正常的，这灵气微薄的世界，能练出一丝法力都难如登天。
“它……它……它过来了……”王总催促长玄道长出手。
然而长玄道长却是一边颤抖着一边后退，哪还记得自己的身份：“你……你别过来……”
顾铮摇摇头，走上前去，顺便拎起地上的一根钢筋，抡圆了带起呼啸的风声砸在纸扎人身上。
咔嚓！
纸扎人瞬间被砸成两半，再加几脚踩成废纸。
哐当丢下钢筋，顾铮回头道：“鬼的确没有，但肯定有装神弄鬼的东西。”
在他眼中，这纸扎人从头到尾没有半点变化，只是静静的站在原地，可是在其他人看来这纸扎人不仅笑了，还移动了脚步。
似乎是被迷了眼睛。
…………
发生纸扎人这样古怪的事情之后，王总看长玄道士师徒的眼神带着怀疑之色，若不是长玄道长星城道教协会的会长，长道观的观主的身份是真的，他都要以为这两人是骗子了。
再加上名头牛逼哄哄却落荒而逃的素善和尚，王总对长玄道士的信任程度大大降低，反而对顾铮热情了许多。
或许是不甘放弃那丰厚的酬劳，长玄道士竟然主动提出再去第八层看看。

不知道为什么，秘书和段高的手电忽然失灵了，四周的灯光暗了不少，忽然的变化令的众人心头发毛，强忍着拔腿而逃的冲动战战兢兢的上了八楼。
这下长玄道士拿出了所有的法器，手中拿着一个罗盘，时而盯着转动的罗盘，时而摇头晃脑喃喃自语，嘴里不时蹦出几个晦涩难懂的词语。
王总还真被他这几下唬住了，多了几分相信：“道长，装神弄鬼的是什么？”
长玄道士沉重道：“猫！成精的猫！这猫怕是有上百年的修为，一直在那山中修行，结果在这里建房子惊扰了它，它这才以幻术装神弄鬼试图吓走你们。”
王总半信半疑，不知道该不该相信长玄道士，下意识的看向顾铮。
长玄道士负手而立，恢复了得道高人的姿态。
自己好歹是正统道教弟子，虽然没有修为，但各种有关妖怪的信息可是了解了不少，黄皮子，狐狸，猫都比较擅长幻术，以幻术迷惑人类，他虽然不知道这装神弄鬼的玩意是什么，但三个选一个，还是有概率选对的。
在他看来，顾铮年纪轻轻不可能有什么真本事，之前多半是误打误撞。
这时候，一道‘咯咯咯咯咯咯’如女人的笑声响起。
毛骨悚然的笑声一响起，所有人都慌了神，手电四下扫射，最后定在一个地方。
黑暗处，闪出一对滴溜溜乱转的小眼睛，随后逐渐露出一张毛绒绒的脸孔，一看之下还以为是狐狸，体态大小和猫差不多。
头大阔口，毛色发黄，定睛一看，那对狡桀奸滑双眼地主人，竟是一只小小的黄鼠狼。
content_en:
"Chang...Changxuan...Taoist Priest..."
Mr. Wang was also dumbfounded. He grabbed Taoist Priest Changxuan and said, "Quick...take action quickly!"
"Oh...oh..."
Taoist Priest Changxuan breathed rapidly and looked panicked. He no longer looked as calm as before. He held up the copper coin sword in his hand tremblingly and shouted feebly:
"What a monster! If you don't get out! I'll be rude to you!"
Gu Zheng glanced sideways at the pair of master and disciple. The disciple's face was pale, his whole body was shaking, and the bag of magic weapons he was carrying was making a clanging sound. The master's stern look on his face, let alone a ghost, was too weak to scare even a child.
It turns out that these two Taoist priests and eminent monks are just ordinary people with no cultivation at all. Their so-called ability to subjugate demons is just pretending to be gods and ghosts.
It's quite normal when you think about it. In this world with meager spiritual energy, it's difficult to develop even a trace of magic power.
"It...it...it's coming..." Mr. Wang urged Taoist Changxuan to take action.
However, Taoist Priest Changxuan retreated while trembling, not remembering his identity: "You...don't come here..."
Gu Zheng shook his head, walked forward, picked up a steel bar on the ground, rounded it up, and hit the paper-pricked man with a roaring wind.
Click!
The person hit by the paper was instantly smashed in half, and a few more feet trampled it into waste paper.
Bangdang dropped the steel bar, and Gu Zheng turned around and said: "There are indeed no ghosts, but there must be people who pretend to be gods and ghosts."
In his eyes, the paper-tied man did not change at all from the beginning to the end, just standing quietly in the same place, but in the eyes of others, the paper-tied man not only smiled, but also moved his steps.
He seemed to be blinded.
…………
After something weird like a paper prick happened, Mr. Wang looked at Changxuan Taoist Master and Disciple with suspicion. If it weren't for the president of Changxuan Taoist Changxing City Taoist Association and the identity of the leader of Chang Taoist Temple, he would have thought that these two people were liars.
Coupled with the fact that Monk Sushan, who had a great reputation but fled in vain, Mr. Wang's trust in Taoist Changxuan was greatly reduced, and he became much more enthusiastic about Gu Zheng.
Perhaps unwilling to give up the generous reward, Taoist Changxuan actually offered to visit the eighth floor again.
For some reason, the flashlights of the secretary and Duan Gao suddenly failed, and the lights around them dimmed a lot. The sudden change made everyone's hearts tremble, and they resisted the urge to run away and went up to the eighth floor tremblingly.
At this time, Taoist Changxuan took out all his magic weapons and held a compass in his hand. Sometimes he stared at the rotating compass, sometimes he shook his head and muttered to himself, and from time to time a few obscure words popped out of his mouth.
Mr. Wang was really frightened by these moves, and he believed him a little more: "Taoist Priest, what are you pretending to be?"
Taoist Changxuan said solemnly: "Cat! A cat that has become a spirit! This cat probably has hundreds of years of cultivation and has been practicing in that mountain. As a result, building a house here disturbed it, so it used illusions to pretend to be gods and ghosts in an attempt to scare you away."
Mr. Wang was dubious, not sure whether he should trust Taoist Changxuan, and looked at Gu Zheng subconsciously.
Taoist Changxuan stood with his hands behind his back, regaining the posture of an accomplished Taoist.
After all, he is an orthodox Taoist disciple. Although he has no cultivation, he knows a lot of information about monsters. Huangpizi, fox, and cat are all good at illusions and use illusions to confuse humans. Although he doesn't know what this pretending to be a ghost is, there is still a chance that he will choose the right one when he chooses one of the three.
In his opinion, Gu Zheng could not have any real abilities at such a young age, and he had probably hit it by mistake before.
At this time, a sound like a woman's laughter sounded.
As soon as the creepy laughter rang out, everyone panicked and fired their flashlights around, finally settling on one place.
In the darkness, a pair of small eyes flashed around, and then a furry face gradually emerged. At first glance, I thought it was a fox, about the same size as a cat.
The head is big and the mouth is wide, and the fur is yellow. If you take a closer look, you can see the pair of cunningThe owner of the treacherous and slippery eyes is actually a little weasel.
